blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Five times the quantity two a minus one, minus three times the quantity a minus two.
Distribute both parts. Five times the quantity two a minus one is ten a minus five. Negative three times the quantity a minus two is negative three a plus six.
Combine like terms. Ten a minus three a is seven a. Negative five plus six is one.
So the answer is seven a plus one.
Watch out for these traps. If you make negative three times negative two negative six, you get seven a minus eleven. If you multiply only the a by negative three, you get seven a minus seven.
